subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should WhatsApp/channel heartbeat visibility grow an OK-only recipient config, and if so should it use target, targets, or a different per-account shape?
rationale: Current code can support a bounded implementation, but adding a new channel config surface affects compatibility, docs, validation, and recipient semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Define additive OK-recipient contract
options.body: Add a backwards-compatible WhatsApp heartbeat recipient shape for OK acknowledgments only, with per-account precedence and allowlist validation.

options.title: Reject new channel recipient config
options.body: Keep the current model where operators use showOk, showAlerts, and agents.defaults.heartbeat.target/to without adding recipient-specific visibility routing.

options.title: Defer to a broader routing design
options.body: Leave this issue open or link a broader channel delivery contract if maintainers want a cross-channel solution rather than a WhatsApp-specific knob.

recommendation.title: Define additive OK-recipient contract
recommendation.body: Add a backwards-compatible WhatsApp heartbeat recipient shape for OK acknowledgments only, with per-account precedence and allowlist validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across the shared WhatsApp schema and outbound heartbeat routing paths plus prior review involvement.
